consent_text: I consent to a home inspection...
desc_asbestos: Old insulation, siding, or tiles possibly containing asbestos
desc_clutter: Blocked exits or unsafe accumulation of items
desc_coldDrafts: Windows or doors that leak air; cold rooms
desc_electrical: Wires without covers, cracked outlets, or shock risk
desc_fallPrevention: No grab bars or non-slip surfaces in key areas
desc_fireEscape: Blocked doors or no clear escape path
desc_flammableStorage: Gasoline, paint, or propane stored unsafely
desc_indoorPollution: Smoking indoors or strong chemical use
desc_leadPaint: Pre-1978 painted surfaces in poor condition
desc_leakingPipes: Water stains, leaks from pipes or ceilings
desc_noCOAlarm: No CO alarm in home with fuel-burning appliances
desc_noHotWater: Broken water heater or no hot water available
desc_noSmokeAlarm: No alarms in bedrooms/hallways or test failure
desc_noVentilation: Lack of windows, fans, or airflow in bathrooms and kitchens
desc_pestDroppings: Visual evidence of rodents, roaches, or other pests
desc_petDander: Pet hair/dander present in home with allergic residents
desc_poorLighting: Dark hallways or poorly lit stairs
desc_radonRisk: No radon test in a high-risk area
desc_structuralDamage: Sagging ceilings, floor cracks, or wall separation
desc_tripHazards: Loose rugs, cords, or cluttered walkways
desc_unsafeStairs: Missing handrails, loose steps, or structural issues
desc_unstoredChemicals: Unsecured cleaners or solvents within reach
desc_waterHazards: Standing water or access to open water without barriers
desc_windowSafety: No guards/stops to prevent falls from windows
